import subprocess, sys, json
from pathlib import Path
script='/work/batch.py'
scenarios=['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']
for sc in scenarios:
    inp='\n' if sc=='live' else None
    cp=subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, sc], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True)
    stderr_lines=[ln for ln in cp.stderr.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    seq=[]
    ok_json=True
    for ln in stderr_lines:
        try:
            rec=json.loads(ln)
        except Exception:
            ok_json=False
            continue
        seq.append(rec.get('sequence'))
    expected=list(range(len(seq)))
    print(f'{sc}: exit={cp.returncode} stderr_records={len(stderr_lines)} json={ok_json} seq_ok={seq==expected} stdout_len={len(cp.stdout.encode())}')
    if seq!=expected:
        print(' seq=',seq)
